A couple things that may help your peace of mind about quality here:

All of our roses are premium own-root plants we grow ourselves at our nurseries in Oregon, not resold from other growers.
Everything is shipped defoliated but healthy, in soil, and covered by a guarantee (1 year on roses, 90 days on perennials, and a failure-to-bloom guarantee on bulbs).
